sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side rooted to the bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches. The visitors have won only once all season and arrive in poor form, making this a winnable fixture for Sandbach to reassert their title credentials.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a key title-race clash, with the away side just two points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of third and fifth respectively, though Bridgnorth have won only once in their last three outings. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social midweek on Wednesday—a double header that could define their week. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton face Shawbury United; Shawbury are in freefall with five consecutive defeats. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-half meeting, Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in another basement-area clash, and Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads. Widnes Town, the division's only winless side, travel to Brereton Social on Saturday as underdogs against an opponent also struggling with recent form.
